Deslocamento do CG

Change in the aircraft’s centre of gravity caused by fuel burn, cargo movement or passenger redistribution, potentially affecting stability limits.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Deslocamento do CG?

In this glossary, Deslocamento do CG refers to: Change in the aircraft’s centre of gravity caused by fuel burn, cargo movement or passenger redistribution, potentially affecting stability limits.

How is Deslocamento do CG used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Despacho, deslocamento CG à frente dois por cento MAC após queima de táxi; favor confirmar."

Why does Deslocamento do CG matter in aviation?

Deslocamento do CG matters because it supports clear communication in Ground Ops contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Who uses Deslocamento do CG?

Deslocamento do CG is mainly used by Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew.

What category does Deslocamento do CG belong to?

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.

Definition

Change in the aircraft’s centre of gravity caused by fuel burn, cargo movement or passenger redistribution, potentially affecting stability limits.

Operational example

Dispatch, a forward CG shift of two percent MAC is indicated after taxi fuel burn; request verification before take-off clearance.

Localized term
